text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH1503, 8-1/2" Nickel Silver Pineapple Door Knocker

The Large Nickel Silver Palm Springs Pineapple Door Knocker features a beautiful combination of polished and satin nickel that highlight the details of this unique front door knocker. The Premium Hospitality Pineapple Door Knocker is a great size for big and standard doors alike. It is 8-1/2 inches tall and 4 inches wide. This surface mounted door knocker has 5-3/16 inch center to centers.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Also Available smaller 6-1/2" Nickel Silver Pineapple Door Knocker

Features and Specifications of the Pineapple Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Nickel Silver
  • Height: 8-1/2
  • Width: 4" at widest part
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 5-3/16"
  • Projection Off Door: 2-1/2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Available in 3 finishes:
Nickel Silver Brass Oiled Bronze

Sold Individually
